body:
A temporary workaround is to add columns, like

```
import streamlit as st

sidebar_expander = st.sidebar.beta_expander("Slim sliders underneath!")
with sidebar_expander:
   _, slider_col, _ = st.beta_columns([0.02, 0.96, 0.02])
   with slider_col:
        st.slider("Slimmer slider", 0, 100, value=0)
        st.slider("Slimmer slider2", 0, 100, value=(0,100))

st.sidebar.slider("Standard layout slider")

```

issue.body: Buttons inside an expander have their red "I was just clicked" glow cropped by the expander. ``` import streamlit as st with st.beta_expander("st.expander"): st.write("hello") st.write("world") st.button("submit") ``` (Looks like this probably the same issue that's reported in #2247 - just needs some CSS margin/padding love, perhaps?)

body:
Ken McGrady commented: In searching for tasks, this looks related. [https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2437|https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2437|smart-link] 

Might want to check and maybe close when this is solved.

Hm, from staring at the images for 5 minutes, it feels as though sliders (and also button highlights in #2437 ) are actually exceeding the bounds of the div; it's been okay in the past since there's nothing on that side anyways, but now Expanders bound the excess, so it's a lot more noticeable.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/856034/105062670-d99ca900-5a48-11eb-80a1-b752805fecea.png)

Two possible approaches:
1. Force sliders (and button outlines, etc) to stay within the parent container by eg adding some more margin to those elements
2. Allow elements to bleed outside expanders

Approach 2 is less work, if there indeed exists a CSS property that allows for it. Let's start looking there.

... Yeah, it's probably just `overflow: visible`. Cool.

## Version 0.76.0

_Release date: February 4, 2021_

**Notable Changes**
- 🎨 [`st.color_picker`](https://docs.streamlit.io/en/0.76.0/api.html#streamlit.color_picker) is now out of beta.
- 🐍 Display a warning when a Streamlit script is run directly as `python script.py`.
- [`st.image`](https://docs.streamlit.io/en/0.76.0/api.html#streamlit.image)'s `use_column_width` now defaults to an `auto` option which will resize the image to the column width if the image exceeds the column width.
- ✂️ Fixed bugs ([2437](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2437) and [2247](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2247)) with content getting cut off within a [`st.beta_expander`](https://docs.streamlit.io/en/0.76.0/api.html#streamlit.beta_expander)
- 📜 Fixed a [bug](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2543) in [`st.dataframe`](https://docs.streamlit.io/en/0.76.0/api.html#streamlit.dataframe) where the scrollbar overlapped with the contents in the last column.
- 💾 Fixed a [bug](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2561) for [`st.file_uploader`](https://docs.streamlit.io/en/0.76.0/api.html#streamlit.file_uploader) where file data returned was not the most recently uploaded file.
- Fixed bugs ([2086](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2086) and [2556](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2556)) where some LaTeX commands were not rendering correctly.
